original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚首例埃博拉死亡病例引发内罗毕居民担忧
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚当局宣布该国出现首例埃博拉死亡病例后，内罗毕多名居民于周三表达恐惧与担忧。卫生部长阿登·杜阿莱称，死者为一名近期从刚果（金）返回的40岁商人，曾在刚果（金）接受治疗。刚果（金）于5月宣布其第17次埃博拉疫情。

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚当局宣布该国首例埃博拉死亡病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenyan authorities announced the country's first-ever Ebola death

key_facts.fact: 内罗毕多名居民在消息公布后表达恐惧与担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Several Nairobi residents expressed fear and concern on Wednesday

key_facts.fact: 卫生部长杜阿莱称死者为一名近期从刚果（金）返回的40岁商人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the death of a man who had recently returned to Kenya from the Democratic Republic of Congo

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）于5月宣布其第17次埃博拉疫情
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Democratic Republic of Congo, which declared its 17th Ebola outbreak in May
